Questions people ask

How much does an AI receptionist cost for a small shop?Published entry prices in our directory run from about $25–$49/mo for light plans (Upfirst, Dialzara, Rosie, OnCrew, ServiceAgent Core) up to $199/mo for unlimited calling (NextPhone). Several tools also offer a free tier or free trial.
Will it book jobs into Jobber or Housecall Pro?Some do natively, some need Zapier, and some only email or text you the lead. Check the listing and the vendor before you buy. We also publish Jobber and Housecall Pro solution pages with integration notes.
AI receptionist or a live answering service?Pure AI is usually cheaper per minute. Human-backed options (Smith.ai, Ruby, Abby Connect) cost more and sound more polished. Many shops start with AI for after-hours and overflow, then add humans if intake needs a person.
